copy.tagline: 用 Chat SDK 接入 WhatsApp 官方消息通道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要接入 WhatsApp 消息的应用。
copy.tagline_en: Add WhatsApp Business Cloud API channel via Chat SDK
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app that needs WhatsApp messaging.

howto.what: 调用后,Claude 会复制并注册 WhatsApp 云适配器、安装固定版依赖并运行构建与测试,让 NanoClaw 可通过 Meta 官方 WhatsApp Business Cloud API 与单个电话号码互发私聊消息(仅一对一,不支持群聊)。
howto.when: 当你说要“接入 WhatsApp Cloud”“给 NanoClaw 添加 whatsapp-cloud 频道”,或要求配置 Meta 官方 WhatsApp Business Cloud API 时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 whatsapp-cloud 频道并完成配置。
say.note: 会按步骤安装并带你设置 Webhook。

say.text: 我要通过 Meta 官方 WhatsApp 接口收发私聊消息。

howto.what_en: On invocation, Claude copies and registers the WhatsApp Cloud adapter, installs the pinned dependency, and runs build/tests so NanoClaw can exchange 1:1 WhatsApp messages (no group chats) via Meta's official API.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to connect WhatsApp Cloud, add a whatsapp-cloud channel to NanoClaw, or mention the official Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API.

say_en.text: Please connect NanoClaw to the WhatsApp Business Cloud API.
say_en.note: It copies and registers the channel, then asks for Meta credentials.

say_en.text: Add the whatsapp-cloud channel and finish the setup.
say_en.note: It runs the install steps and guides webhook configuration.

say_en.text: I want to send and receive 1:1 WhatsApp messages via Meta's official API.
say_en.note: It configures the WhatsApp Cloud channel for NanoClaw.
